options.text: Two idlis with sambar in the morning.
A whole large packet of candy just before bed.
One candy only, because the smallest portion is always healthiest.
A brightly iced cupcake at midnight, chosen for its colours.

stem: Bilal chooses breakfast. Which choice supports healthy eating: wholesome food, a moderate amount, and a suitable time?

teacher.key_rationale: Healthy eating needs wholesome food, a moderate amount, and a suitable time. Candy overload, tiniest-portion rule, and colour-only choices miss that checklist.
